strings.jp:
デュラン!
お前、何のつもりだ!?
strings.en:
Durant! What do you
think you're doin'!?

strings.jp:
これも戦の習︀い…
ミラノ殿!　お覚悟を!
strings.en:
Such is war, Milanor-dono!
Prepare yourself!

strings.jp:
チッ!　やり難い相手だが…
やるしかねーか!
strings.en:
Tch! Not a guy I wanna
fight... but here goes!

strings.jp:
お許しを…
ミラノ殿……!

たとえ相手が誰であろうとも…
勝負で手は抜きません!
strings.en:
No matter who my foe is...
I do not slack in a duel!

As expected of the
King of Thieves...

strings.jp: ホメたって何も出ねーぞ?
strings.en:
Flattery won't get ya
anything, y'know?
